test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

I'm ___________ about whether to accept the job offer or continue freelancing. Both options have their advantages.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"on the fence"** means to be undecided or unsure about something. (दुविधा में होना)

 
 
• **Example: **She is** on the fence** about whether to move to a new city or stay in her hometown.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cutting corners** (कामचलाऊ उपाय करना): Doing something in the easiest, cheapest, or fastest way.

 
 
• **Example: **The contractor was fired for cutting corners on the building project.
 
 
 
• **Left out in the cold** (नजरअंदाज कर दिया जाना): Being ignored or excluded.
 
 
• **Example: **She felt left out in the cold when she wasn't invited to the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Up in arms** (बहुत नाराज या परेशान होना): Being very angry or upset.
 
 
• **Example: **The residents were up in arms about the new parking regulations.
 
 

136:Tb92,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.</di
